mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_images (activity_id, file_object_id, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{fileObjectId}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, activity_id, file_object_id, sort_order, created_at FROM activity_images WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT ai.id, ai.activity_id, ai.file_object_id, ai.sort_order, ai.created_at, fo.storage_key, fo.original_name FROM activity_images ai JOIN file_objects fo ON fo.id = ai.file_object_id WHERE ai.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY ai.sort_order ASC, ai.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_images SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
